specs.label: Frequency Response
specs.value: 20 Hz - 20 kHz (+/- 1 dB) Line Input, 63 Hz - 15 kHz (+/- 3 dB) System Specification (wireless end-to-end with LR-4200)

specs.label: Signal-to-Noise Ratio
specs.value: > 70 dB (SNR) Line Input, > 60 dB (SNR) System Specification (wireless end-to-end with LR-4200)

specs.label: Microphone Input
specs.value: Two (2) 3.5 mm (0.14 in.) Tip/Sleeve connector, -30 dBu nominal input, +14 dB headroom, impedance 4.4k Ohms, 5 VDC bias supply

specs.label: Total Harmonic Distortion
specs.value: < 0.1% (THD) Line Input, < 2% (THD) System Specification (wireless end-to-end with LR-4200)

specs.label: Unbalanced Line Input
specs.value: Stereo/Mono Input. Two (2) Dual (RCA) Phono connectors, unbalanced, -10 dBu nominal input, +14 dB headroom, impedance 10k Ohms

specs.label: Balanced Line Input
specs.value: Mono Input. Two (2) Phoenix Type connector, balanced, + 4 dBu nominal input, +14 dB headroom, impedance 100k Ohms

specs.label: Power Switch
specs.value: Three (3) position switch - Power OFF, Power ON-Indicator Lights OFF, Power ON-Indicator Lights ON

specs.label: Carrier Frequency Selection
specs.value: Two (2), four (4) position rotary switches (2.3 MHz, 2.8 MHz, 3.3 MHz, 3.8 MHz)

specs.label: Level Control Knob
specs.value: Two (2) audio taper rotary potentiometer, counter-clockwise decreases input mix level, clockwise increases input mix level

specs.label: Audio Level Indicators
specs.value: Two (2) Green LEDs, two (2) Red LEDs, Green LED indicates Audio presence and Red LED indicates peaks in the audio

specs.label: RJ-45 Amber LED
specs.value: Solid Amber indicates carrier is present and IR is being transmitted

specs.label: RJ-45 Green LED
specs.value: Solid Green indicates power is applied to unit, flashing indicates unit has entered power save mode
